heading: INT. SENTENCING HEARING, SMALL COURTROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. SENTENCING HEARING, SMALL COURTROOM - DAY
A modest county courtroom, oak benches worn smooth by decades of hands.
A flag in the corner, faded by afternoon light.
A stenographer's keys click and then stop.
JUDGE CORNELIUS ABERNATHY-OKOYE (70s, a face like folded paper, half-moon glasses) looks down from the bench.
Before him, standing at the defense table, a woman in a plain gray suit: SERAPHINA DUBOIS-TANAKA (40s, bookkeeper, wedding ring she keeps turning).
Beside her, her ATTORNEY, MALCOLM ASHFORD-IGWE (50s, silvered temples), holds a single sheet of paper.
Across the aisle, the PROSECUTOR, ODALYS FERRARI-NKEMELU (30s, hair in a low knot), sits very straight.
Mr. Ashford-Igwe. You wished to be heard.
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: I did, Your Honor.
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: Go ahead.
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: My client has no prior record.
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: The State recommends the maximum.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: Each hears the other.
Malcolm stops.
Odalys does not.
She embezzled four hundred thousand dollars from a church fund.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: She repaid three hundred and ten.
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: After she was caught.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: Before she was charged.
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: Counsel, one at a time.
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: He lifts his glasses and rubs the bridge of his nose.
Seraphina's thumb has gone still on her ring.
Ms. Dubois-Tanaka. Is there something you wish to say?
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: No, sir.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: You're allowed.
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: I know.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: Then I'll ask again.
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: She glances at Malcolm, who gives the smallest nod.
She lets go of her ring and rests both hands flat on the table.
My mother was ill. The church was kind, and I was careful, and then I wasn't.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: Go on.
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: That's all of it, Your Honor.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: Silence.
The flag stirs in a draft from the air vent.
Odalys looks at her own folded hands.
Ms. Ferrari-Nkemelu. Does the State wish to respond?
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: No, Your Honor.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: No?
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: The State withdraws its recommendation.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: Malcolm looks at her sharply.
She doesn't look back.
Seraphina's shoulders drop an inch.
I'll take the matter under advisement.
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: He closes the folder.
The gavel rises, hovers, comes down gently.
We're adjourned.
units.name: ABERNATHY

units.text: He stands.
The courtroom stirs.
Seraphina stays where she is, gazing at the empty bench.
